name: ViDiC
abstract: ViDiC evaluates video difference captioning by measuring how well models describe fine-grained differences and similarities between videos. This page uses the Average score from the main table.
method: This work extends difference captioning from images to videos, requiring models to describe differences, similarities, and temporal changes between paired videos.
It emphasizes fine-grained factors such as position, background, camera motion, and filming technique, making the task more comparative than standard captioning.
The main results show strong performance from leading language models, but clear weaknesses remain on fine-grained categories.
